text: At its meeting July 17, 18 and 19, 2019, through Item TE7.15 , City Council authorized staff to enter into a Section 37 Agreement with MOD Developments (Charles) Inc. and 2690799 Ontario Inc. being the owners of 55 Charles Street East ("MOD"), to secure community benefits which included the transfer of the 218 Carlton Street property ("the Property") to the City, at no cost, for use as affordable rental housing. Prior to the transfer of the Property to the City, MOD is required to complete extensive renovations and make the Property suitable for its intended use. The Property, including the cost of acquisition and renovations, was valued at $6,400,000. City Council also authorized staff to issue a Request for Proposals to select a non-profit operator to lease 218 Carlton Street from the City for a term of 50 years.
